description: Check camber and total toe against broad autocross and track baseline ranges. Calculates from measured inputs without authentication and does not read or save account data. This is a baseline checker, not a vehicle-specific prescription. Tire wear and driver feedback decide the next step.

frontToe.description: Front total toe (in in imperial; mm in metric)

rearToe.description: Rear total toe (in in imperial; mm in metric)

unitSystem.description: Units for all inputs and results, as specified on each field.
